requirement.evidence: A housing provider shall not make any oral or written inquiry regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to making a conditional offer.
requirement.note: Exceptions for methamphetamine production on federally assisted housing and lifetime sex offender registration, and the right to provide evidence of inaccuracies or rehabilitation, are in section 4a.
